capabilities: Colorize tags from a generated palette
Mix nested tag colors with the root tag color
Assign a palette color to individual tags via tag assignments
Adjust text contrast to WCAG 2.1 AA and adapt colors for the dark theme
extras: Installable via BRAT (pfrankov/obsidian-colored-tags). The README warns that tag colors may change in upcoming updates, since the goal is visual distinctiveness rather than stable colors. Only palette colors are supported; custom per-tag colors are not.
motivation: The README states the main idea is to make tags visually different from each other; no further author motivation is given.
problem: Obsidian renders all tags the same way, so it is hard to visually tell different tags apart in notes.
summary: Tag colorizer that gives each tag a distinct palette color, blends nested tag colors with the root tag, and auto-adjusts text contrast for dark themes.
